n: EU Code Week Code through Art
t: Three lesson plans that mix pixel art, grid play, and a Bee-bot for ages 4-6.
steps: Find the Code Through Art page on the EU Code Week site.
Gather materials for a floor grid.
Start with the unplugged Artful Coding plan.
Charge the Bee-bot for the Creative Code Lab.
Set up the Makey Makey kit for Touch Canvas.
Check the license before sharing adapted copies.
